Requirements AND Programs 
for Exchange Students 
 
 Korean Track 
• Students with TOPIK 3 or equivalent can take major/elective c ourses 
except for medical related courses in medical campus. 
⬧ Students take Korean language classes at the Korean language Center. 
→ Four subjects, three credits each, 12 credits in total for 10 weeks 
(Mon to Fri / 09:00 - 13:00 or 14:00 - 18:00) 
 
• Students without TOPIK 3 take Korean language classes at the liberal arts 
college. 
→ Five subjects, three credits each, 15 credits in total, three hours per 
day 
⬧ Students can only take one basic elective course about Korean or 
Korean culture. 
 
 English Track 
• Over TOEFL IBT 70 or IELTS 5.5 or TOEIC 700 score is required. 
• Students can take English-taught major/elective courses except for  
medical related courses in medical campus. 
• Only Business and Computer Engineering majors are taught in English. 
major classes.

2 
Admissions 
Period of 
Exchange 
One semester or one academic year 
(According to the student exchange agreement between two universities) 
Eligibility 
- Completion of at least two semester of study and currently in the process of pursuing  
a degree at home institution. 
- GPA higher than 2.5/4.5 is recommended. 
Application Time 
Table 
Semester Nomination Deadline Application Deadline 
Spring Before Oct 15th Before Oct 31st 
Fall Before Apr 15st Before Apr 30th 
• Before the nomination, exchange coordinators MUST con sult with Gachon inboun d 
exchange program coordinator about the number of student nominees. 
• Once the number of nominees has been confirmed, the exchange coordinators may 
send the scanned copy of all the required documents for application to Gachon 
University by the deadline via an email. 
• To nominate a master's student, prior consultation is mandatory.  
(Currently, only the Department of Computer Engineering is available for the Master's 
English-taught program.) 
Required 
Documents for 
Application 
 
1. Application form 
2. Official Transcript (English) 
3. Certificate of Enrollment (English)  
* Students with a non-OECD nationality must obtain an Apostille or Verification by the Korean 
Consulate, 中国大学的学生请提交学信网资料 
4. A recommendation letter from a faculty member or the office responsibl 
5. A copy of passport 
6. A copy of travel insurance 
7. Language Proficiency Certificate (if applicable)  
8. A copy of bank statements showing a minimum balance of USD 4,000 for one semester

Other Information 
Visa Requirement 
All the exchange students need to obtain the D -2 VISA with the Certificate of 
admission and invitation letter which are provided by Gachon. Students are advised to 
contact Korean embassy in their home country for more details about VISA. 
Residence Permit 
(Alien Registration 
Card) 
All the exchange students must apply for the alien registration card within 90 days of 
entry.  
A group application is arranged at the beginning of each semester. 
Insurance 
All exchange students should purchase travel insurance in their home country and 
submit a copy of the insurance presenting his/her name with oth er documents. The 
copy of an insurance must be accompanied with an English translation. 
Buddy Program Buddy groups assigned to each language group will support you throughout your 
exchange period.

4 
On-campus Housing 
Gachon University provides on-campus housing for all the exchange students.  
All rooms are twin/triple occupancy in principle.  
Gachon University do not offer the off-campus housing for the exchange students.  
 
* Room type that you have requested may be changed according to the availability of 
the dormitory. Bunk beds are equipped in the triple rooms so it could be cramped and 
students may not have enough personal space. 
* A deposit of 100,000KRW is required upon initial move-in. 
* Public facilities may not be sufficient. (e.g. Students shall apply for the space for the  
fridge and it is allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.) 
* Please note that the dormitory is not a new building, some facilities may be worn out. 
* Dormitory only provides bed sheets, and other bedding is not provided. 
- If you rent bedding through a rental company, you can receive it on the day you 
move into the dorm. (Details will be provided by the rental company via email.) 
 
TB Test All the exchange students who stay in the on-campus housing must submit negative 
TB result tested in Korea no later than the day after the check-in. 
Living Expenses 
The living expenses will be approximately 1,000,000 KRW per month. 
 
 Lunch or dinner at a restaurant near the campus: 10,000 KRW 
Cafeteria is located in Dorm 3. (KRW 6,000) 
 Public Bus/Subway ticket (one way): 1,550 KRW 
 Taxi: 4,800 KRW+(day) / 5,800-6,700KRW+(night)
